attr.title: DigiScreen-Stream
attr.desc:
DigiScreen plus the FatmaVision screen stream: mirrors an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt screen on the handheld while streaming the handheld's display (fb0 -> H.264 tcp:5555) so the FatmaVision app can watch remotely. The stream starts first, then DigiScreen; the stream stops when DigiScreen exits.

Runs inside the vaixterm terminal emulator with a full gptokeyb gamepad control layer: A=save frame, B=quit stream back to pairing, X=render mode, Y=invert, L1=help, R1=flip, L2/R2=pause. Requires the DigiScreen port and an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt connected by USB-MIDI.
attr.inst: Install the DigiScreen port first, then this one. Connect the Elektron box by USB-MIDI (GLOBAL > USB CFG > USB MIDI). The stream serves one client on TCP 5555 -- open it in the FatmaVision app. Exit with the EmulationStation hotkey; the stream stops with DigiScreen.
